_safety_config._doc: Track A safety gate. revert_enabled=false ships in alert-only mode (Stage 1); flip to true after pdp-atc-001 cycle 1 calibration to enable live auto-revert (Stage 2). stale_snapshot_hours bounds how old a current_metrics snapshot can be before the cron skips guardrail evaluation.

pdp-atc.seeded_hypothesis: Flip PDP buy-box default from one-time to subscription-first presentation (subscription option selected/rendered above one-time) to test whether anchoring to the higher-value option and simplifying the choice architecture lifts add-to-cart rate. Changing element: buy-box default state and option ordering in snippets/buy-buttons.liquid. Data rationale: hypothesis #4 in pdp-atc build-spec backlog; subscription-first is a known LTV lever and the compound effect on ATC is untested on Kenetik's audience. Expected direction: ATC rate up (+). Disproof: ATC rate flat or down at 95% confidence over 7-day measurement window, or subscription attach rate drop with no net ATC lift (pure cannibalization). Seeded 2026-04-24 by Katie for first live T2 validation cycle.
pdp-atc.hypothesis: Reorder buy-box so Subscribe & Save 20% renders above One-time purchase, but keep One-time as the default `checked` option. Tests whether ordering alone (without forcing the higher-commitment default) anchors users on the higher-value option enough to lift ATC, without the cart-to-purchase cannibalization observed in cycle 1 (subscription-first + preselect: ATC +5.7%, CVR -19.2% tier-2 breach). Changing element: purchase_type_ordering on sections/cw-01-product-banner.liquid lines 266-348 — swap DOM order of the two .wn-product__purchase-options divs; purchase_type_default_selection unchanged (still one-time). Expected direction: ATC rate up modestly (+); CVR holds within tier-2 (no worse than -10% vs control). Disproof: ATC rate flat or down at 95% credible interval over 7-day window, OR CVR drop >10% relative to control. Seeded by Katie via Slack thread (2026-05-12) following cycle 1 paused_for_review outcome.
